answer: The onyx register is checked at draw time, crystal lists the eligible set, and dawn seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 68 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 68 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 330 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
